Pay: Rs. 27,300.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement is purely on contract basis under National Health Mission (NHM). Does not confer any right for regular appointment under the Government.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favor of District Medical & Health Officer, Suryapet.

content_sections.heading: How Will DMHO Suryapet Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made strictly on merit. Merit shall be calculated on the basis of combined percentage of marks obtained in Qualifying Examination (90 marks) and Age (10 marks). Rule of Reservation and Presidential Order, 2018 shall be followed. Provisional merit list display and objection inviting. Final selection list preparation. 90 marks for Qualifying Examination percentage 10 marks for Age

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: SSC/10th Class Certificate for proof of age Educational/Technical Qualification Certificates Marks memos of all years/semesters of the qualifying course Registration certificate issued by the concerned statutory council Community/Caste Certificate, wherever applicable Local/Candidature/Study Certificates, wherever applicable Aadhaar Card/other prescribed identity proof Proof of payment of application fee

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMHO Suryapet Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates shall submit their applications in the prescribed format enclosed as Application Form. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents along with the application. Submit the application in person or by post to: The District Medical & Health Officer, F25, IDOC, Suryapet District, Telangana. Submission timing is from 14.10.2026 to 21.10.2026 between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM on all working days.

content_sections.text: Demand Draft to be paid in Favor of District Medical & Health Officer, Suryapet.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DMHO Suryapet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DMHO Suryapet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 5 2nd ANM, 3 Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DMHO Suryapet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Attached to the PDF notification) and send it to District Medical & Health Officer, F25, IDOC, Suryapet District, Telangana, by by hand or in person / post, to reach by 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General Candidates: Rs. 500. EWS/BC/SC/ST/Minority/Ex-Ser./PHC candidates: Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/BC/EWS 5, Ex-Servicemen 3, Physically Challenged 10.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 27,300 for 2nd ANM, Rs. 27,300 for Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10+2 with Diploma in Pharmacy/B.Pharmacy for Pharmacist; 10+2 with Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Female) Training Course for ANM. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Posts are Zonal posts. Selected candidates are required to work at the Ayushman Arogya Mandirs/Subcenters allotted to them.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications or applications without required documents. Applications received after the prescribed last date and time.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection shall be made strictly on merit. Merit shall be calculated on the basis of combined percentage of marks obtained in Qualifying Examination (90 marks) and Age (10 marks). Rule of Reservation and Presidential Order, 2018 shall be followed. Provisional merit list display and objection inviting.
